reasoning_content:
The token endpoint gives an anonymous token. Let me use it to list tags.

The remote registry is publicly pullable (anonymous). Let me list tags.

action.command: TOKEN=$(timeout 30 curl -s "https://8gears.container-registry.com/service/token?service=harbor-registry&scope=repository:8gcr/harbor-core:pull" | sed 's/.*"token":"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/'); echo "token len: ${#TOKEN}"; timeout 30 curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://8gears.container-registry.com/v2/8gcr/harbor-core/tags/list" | head -c 2000
